sentences.en: Have you ever walked into a school or workplace and found yourself wondering
sentences.zh: 你是否曾走进一所学校或职场，发现自己在想

sentences.en: what the people there think of you?
sentences.zh: 那里的人是怎么看你的？

sentences.en: Are they judging you because you're a woman?
sentences.zh: 他们是不是因为你是女性而在评判你？

sentences.en: Why are they staring at me?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们要盯着我看？

sentences.en: I wonder if they'll think I have an accent when I speak.
sentences.zh: 我在想，我说话时他们会不会觉得我有口音。

sentences.en: Has this affected what you say, whether you speak, and how you act?
sentences.zh: 这是否影响了你的言谈、你是否开口以及你的行事方式？

sentences.en: I hope they don't think I'm boring.
sentences.zh: 我希望他们不觉得我很无趣。

sentences.en: Is there something in my teeth?
sentences.zh: 我牙齿上是不是粘了什么东西？

sentences.en: Maybe if I just sit over here and I don't say anything, maybe they won't notice me.
sentences.zh: 也许我只要坐在这一言不发，他们就不会注意到我。

sentences.en: On the surface, it would seem like the impressions other people have of us
sentences.zh: 表面上看，别人对我们的印象
似乎只存在于他们的脑海里。

sentences.en: It shouldn't affect the way we think or feel or act.
sentences.zh: 它不应该影响我们的想法、感受或行为。

sentences.en: But our concerns about other people's perceptions
sentences.zh: 但我们对他人看法的担忧

sentences.en: have a way of burrowing deep into our minds.
sentences.zh: 总会深深地钻进我们的脑海中。

sentences.en: Is it because I'm too tall?
This week on Hidden Brain, how our worries about the stereotypes people hold of us
sentences.zh: 本周的《隐藏的大脑》将探讨我们对他人刻板印象的担忧

sentences.en: can shape everything from parent-teacher conferences to police shootings.
sentences.zh: 如何塑造从家长会到警察枪击事件的方方面面。

sentences.en: We all have memories of summers gone by, of long walks and lazy afternoons,
sentences.zh: 我们对逝去的夏天都有着记忆，漫长的散步和慵懒的午后，

sentences.en: relaxing by a pool, vacations with friends and family.
sentences.zh: 在泳池边放松，与朋友和家人的假期。

sentences.en: Claude Steele has a less pleasant memory of one long-ago summer.
sentences.zh: 克劳德·斯蒂尔对一个遥远的夏天有着不那么愉快的记忆。

sentences.en: He was with a group of kids coming home from school.
sentences.zh: 当时他和一群放学回家的孩子在一起。

sentences.en: It was the 1950s, and they were in Phoenix, a small town just south of Chicago.
sentences.zh: 那是20世纪50年代，他们在菲尼克斯，芝加哥正南方的一个小镇。

sentences.en: You know, we were just walking along, each of us peeling off as we got closer to our houses.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们当时就在路上走着，随着离各自的家越来越近，大家一个个分流离开。

sentences.en: Claude was six or seven years old.
And we're coming home on the last day of school, school's out.
sentences.zh: 我们在学年最后一天放学回家，学校放假了。

sentences.en: The promise of a golden summer stretched out before them.
sentences.zh: 金色夏天的承诺在他们面前铺展开来。

sentences.en: Everyone was talking about how they would spend the coming months of vacation,
sentences.zh: 每个人都在谈论他们将如何度过接下来的几个月的假期，

sentences.en: And then one of the older kids said something that seared the moment into Claude's memory.
sentences.zh: 然后，一个较大的孩子说的一句话，把那一刻永远烙印在了克劳德的记忆中。

sentences.en: We're talking about what we're going to do, just a sort of gang of kids coming home in the summer.
sentences.zh: 我们在谈论要做什么，就像一群孩子在夏天结伴回家那样。

sentences.en: And somebody says, I'm going to go swimming.
sentences.zh: 然后有人说，我要去游泳。

sentences.en: And somebody else says, no, you can't go swimming in that.
sentences.zh: 另一个人说，不，你不能在那儿游泳。

sentences.en: You can't go swimming in the Harvey Park pool unless you go on Wednesday afternoons.
sentences.zh: 除非你在星期三下午去，否则你不能去哈维公园泳池游泳。

sentences.en: That's the only time we're allowed there.
sentences.zh: 那是我们唯一被允许去的时间。

sentences.en: Claude didn't fully understand what the older kid meant,
sentences.zh: 克劳德并不完全理解那个大孩子的意思，

sentences.en: but he knew there was an important subtext to the statement.
sentences.zh: 但他知道这句话有着重要的潜台词。

sentences.en: That's the only time we're allowed there.
sentences.zh: 那是我们唯一被允许去的时间。
这不仅仅是又一条规定。

sentences.en: There was something about this particular rule that was freighted with meaning.
sentences.zh: 这条特定的规则有些不同寻常，充满了意味。

sentences.en: The rule was about them, these particular boys.
sentences.zh: 这条规则是针对他们的，针对这些特定的男孩。

sentences.en: It wasn't that the pool was only open on Wednesday afternoons.
sentences.zh: 并不是说这个泳池只在星期三下午开放。

sentences.en: There was something about these kids that meant that they could only use the pool on Wednesday afternoons.
sentences.zh: 而是这些孩子的某些特质意味着他们只能在星期三下午使用泳池。

sentences.en: Claude listened intently the way kids do
sentences.zh: 克劳德聚精会神地听着，就像孩子们那样，

sentences.en: when they realized they have just found a portal into the grown-up world.
sentences.zh: 当他们意识到自己刚刚找到了通往成人世界的入口时。

sentences.en: It emerged from somebody else that, no, we can't just go there any time.
sentences.zh: 从别人那里冒出来这样的话：不，我们不能随时去那里。

sentences.en: Only time black people, only time Negro people.
sentences.zh: 只有黑人，只有黑人能去的时间。

sentences.en: I'm not even sure what term we used in those days.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不确定我们当年用的是什么词。

sentences.en: We can only go on Wednesday afternoons.
sentences.zh: 我们只能在星期三下午去。

sentences.en: And that was stunning to the group.
sentences.zh: 这对大家来说是个晴天霹雳。

sentences.en: I just think, you know, first it was a little mild resistance,
sentences.zh: 我只觉得，你知道的，起初有点轻微的抵触，

sentences.en: but somehow we knew that it was true.
sentences.zh: 但不知何故，我们知道这是真的。

sentences.en: I remember just kind of quieting.
sentences.zh: 我记得自己只是安静了下来。

sentences.en: At least I could be constructing this memory,
sentences.zh: 至少这段记忆可能是我脑补出来的，

sentences.en: but I have a sense of just being puzzled and kind of stopped.
sentences.zh: 但我有一种感到困惑和仿佛被按下暂停键的感觉。

sentences.en: What it meant was that on Wednesday afternoons,
sentences.zh: 这意味着在星期三下午，

sentences.en: kids from Phoenix, which was predominantly black,
sentences.zh: 来自菲尼克斯（那里的居民主要是黑人）的孩子们

sentences.en: would troop over to the neighboring village of Harvey,
sentences.zh: 会成群结队地走到相邻的哈维村，
那里的居民主要是白人。

sentences.en: There would be in Phoenix, leading out of Phoenix
sentences.zh: 在菲尼克斯会形成这样的场景：从菲尼克斯出发，

sentences.en: and going toward the Harvey Park pool on Wednesday afternoons,
sentences.zh: 在星期三下午前往哈维公园泳池，

sentences.en: a kind of long line of black kids with their swimming trunks wrapped in a towel
sentences.zh: 长长的一队黑人孩子，把泳裤包在毛巾里，

sentences.en: and going to swim in the swimming pool.
And, you know, you got used to it,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，你习惯了这一切，

sentences.en: but that made you aware that there was something about you,
sentences.zh: 但这让你意识到你身上有些东西，

sentences.en: something about your group that was different
sentences.zh: 你所属的群体有些东西是不同的，

sentences.en: and that had some real significance.
sentences.zh: 并且具有某种真正的意义。

sentences.en: And I just remember feeling kind of a quiet anger about it, a resentment.
sentences.zh: 我只记得当时心中有一种无声的愤怒和怨恨。

sentences.en: A question was forming in Claude's mind,
sentences.zh: 克劳德的心中正在形成一个问题，

sentences.en: and it was a question that would come to animate the following decades of his life
sentences.zh: 这个问题将在他未来的几十年生活中不断激荡，

sentences.en: as he became a renowned psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 当时他已成为了一位著名的心理学家。

sentences.en: What did these people think of us?
sentences.zh: 这些人是怎么看我们的？

sentences.en: As the white residents of Harvey looked out their windows on Wednesday afternoons,
sentences.zh: 当哈维的白人居民在星期三下午从窗户向外看时，

sentences.en: what did they make of the line of black children walking to the pool?
sentences.zh: 他们是如何看待走向泳池的一队黑人儿童的？

sentences.en: What kind of attitudes did they have?
sentences.zh: 他们有着什么样的态度？

sentences.en: In time, Claude began to get answers to those questions.
sentences.zh: 渐渐地，克劳德开始找到这些问题的答案。

sentences.en: It wasn't like someone stopped and told him,
sentences.zh: 并不是有人特意停下来告诉他，

sentences.en: here's what we think of you.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们对你的看法。

sentences.en: It was communicated, like most everything else,
sentences.zh: 这种信息是通过人们对待他和他的家人的方式传达出来的，

sentences.en: through how people acted toward him, toward his family.
There was a white school and a black school.
sentences.zh: 当时有一所白人学校和一所黑人学校。

sentences.en: And the black schools usually had vastly different resources than the white school.
sentences.zh: 黑人学校的资源通常与白人学校有着天壤之别。

sentences.en: You know, you learn that the roller skating rink
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你会发现旱冰场

sentences.en: is only open to African Americans on Thursday nights.
sentences.zh: 只在星期四晚上对非裔美国人开放。

sentences.en: You can buy clothes in the department stores, but you can't try them on.
sentences.zh: 你可以在百货公司买衣服，但你不能试穿。

sentences.en: I remember my brother wanting to be on the baseball team
sentences.zh: 我记得我弟弟想加入棒球队，

sentences.en: as they were loading themselves onto the bus in front of the YMCA building,
sentences.zh: 于青年会大楼前登上一辆辆大巴时告诉他，

sentences.en: Soon, there were experiences involving odd jobs and work.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，便有了涉及杂活和工作的经历。

sentences.en: Claude's parents made it clear they expected him and his brother
sentences.zh: 克劳德的父母明确表示，他们期望他和弟弟

sentences.en: We were not a family with a lot of resources,
sentences.zh: 我们不是一个资源丰富的家庭，

sentences.en: Our parents also made this abundantly clear.
sentences.zh: 我们的父母也将这一点说得极其明白。

sentences.en: They picked vegetables on a farm.
They did lawn detail at the home of a doctor in Harvey.
sentences.zh: 他们在哈维的一位医生家里修剪草坪。

sentences.en: When they were teenagers, maybe 13 or so,
sentences.zh: 当他们是青少年的时候，大概13岁左右，

sentences.en: Claude and his brother got a tip about work at a golf course.
sentences.zh: 克劳德和弟弟得到了一条关于在高尔夫球场工作的线索。

sentences.en: We heard from some white friends of ours that they'd become caddies.
sentences.zh: 我们从一些白人朋友那里听说他们当过球童。

sentences.en: So we thought, let's give it a try.
sentences.zh: 所以我们想，不妨去试试。

sentences.en: Claude and his brother decided to take the train out from Phoenix one morning.
sentences.zh: 一天早上，克劳德和弟弟决定从菲尼克斯坐火车出发。

sentences.en: If you got there early, you got a good number.
sentences.zh: 如果你去得早，就能拿到一个好号码。

sentences.en: The lower your number, the more likely you'd be called
sentences.zh: 你的号码越靠前，被叫到的可能性就越大，

sentences.en: and the more work you'd get.
sentences.zh: 能得到的工作也就越多。

sentences.en: It was 5, 6 o'clock in the morning.
Claude and his brother were pleased to see
sentences.zh: 克劳德和弟弟很高兴地发现

sentences.en: they were among the first to get to the golf course.
sentences.zh: 他们是第一批到达高尔夫球场的人之一。

sentences.en: They were pretty sure they would get caddy badges.
sentences.zh: 他们确信自己能拿到球童证。

sentences.en: Kids came in all day and they were given badges.
sentences.zh: 孩子们陆陆续续来了一整天，都拿到了徽章。

sentences.en: Each time another kid was given a caddy badge,
sentences.zh: 每当另一个孩子拿到球童证时，

sentences.en: OK, it'll be our turn next.
sentences.zh: 好了，下一个该轮到我们了。

sentences.en: And this went on all day.
sentences.zh: 这种情况持续了一整天。
我是说，直到下午晚些时候。
然后，在所有其他人之后，

sentences.en: I mean, dozens and dozens of kids had been given caddy badges.
sentences.zh: 我是说，几十个甚至上百个孩子都拿到了球童证之后，

sentences.en: One of the adults came out and looked at us and said,
sentences.zh: 其中一个成年人走出来看着我们说：

sentences.en: you, using the N-word, are still here?
sentences.zh: 你居然还敢留在这里用这个词？

sentences.en: We're not giving you a badge.
sentences.zh: 我们是不会给你徽章的。

sentences.en: Claude and his brother felt humiliated.
sentences.zh: 克劳德和他的哥哥感到受到了羞辱。

sentences.en: It was obvious what the people who ran the golf course thought of them.
sentences.zh: 经营高尔夫球场的人对他们的看法显而易见。

sentences.en: I do remember sort of, you know, slouching back to the train
sentences.zh: 我确实还记得，怎么说呢，垂头丧气地走回火车站

sentences.en: and getting on it and taking it back home
and talking to our parents about it.
sentences.zh: 并跟我们的父母谈起了这件事。

sentences.en: I have the sense it was a weekend night and we talked about it.
sentences.zh: 我记得那是周末的晚上，我们讨论了这件事。

sentences.en: The boys were crushed as they shared what had happened.
sentences.zh: 男孩们分享了发生的遭遇，内心备受打击。

sentences.en: Their parents listened attentively and tried to comfort them.
sentences.zh: 他们的父母认真倾听并试图安慰他们。

sentences.en: What do you tell teenagers who have experienced naked prejudice?
sentences.zh: 你该对经历了赤裸裸偏见的青少年说些什么呢？

sentences.en: How do you explain what happened?
sentences.zh: 你该如何解释发生的事情？

sentences.en: When I think about it, I do think of the warmth of my parents
sentences.zh: 每当我想起这件事，我确实能感受到父母的温暖

sentences.en: and the support, the intelligence of my parents
sentences.zh: 还有父母的支持与智慧
他们能以一种真实的方式

sentences.en: and explain this thing as best you could possibly explain it.
sentences.zh: 尽其所能地把这件事解释清楚。

sentences.en: Claude's parents knew all about that illness.
sentences.zh: 克劳德的父母对这种病态心知肚明。

sentences.en: They were both active in the civil rights movement.
sentences.zh: 他们都积极投身于民权运动。

sentences.en: And in those days when that happened,
sentences.zh: 在那个发生这种事的年代，

sentences.en: and moved into the black world, black community.
sentences.zh: 并融入黑人的世界和黑人社区。

sentences.en: And that definitely is what happened in our family.
sentences.zh: 我们的家庭确实就是这样的情况。

sentences.en: We had very minimal contact with her family.
sentences.zh: 我们和她娘家几乎没有什么联系。

sentences.en: Her parents eventually came and met us.
sentences.zh: 她的父母后来来看望过我们。

sentences.en: But I was old enough to remember that

sentences.zh: 也就是我的外祖父母最终到来的时候。

sentences.en: But we never, ever saw any of her siblings or cousins
sentences.zh: 但我们从来、从来没见过她那边的任何兄弟姐妹、表亲

sentences.en: or anything on that side of the family.
sentences.zh: 或是那个家族的其他人。

sentences.en: So that was how it worked.
For Claude's dad, who worked as a truck driver,
sentences.zh: 对克劳德的父亲来说，他是一名卡车司机，

sentences.en: these conversations and the anxiety that provoked them
sentences.zh: 这些谈话以及它们引发的焦虑

sentences.en: were an ever-present part of his workday.
sentences.zh: 是他日常工作挥之不去的一部分。

sentences.en: You know, he was constantly worried
rather than give him all of the benefits
sentences.zh: 公司非但不会给他所有的福利

sentences.en: he might do as his seniority increased,
sentences.zh: ——本该随着他资历的增加而增加的福利，

sentences.en: that they might try to fire him
sentences.zh: 反而可能会试图解雇他，

sentences.en: because that's what he and his friends talked about.
sentences.zh: 因为他和朋友们谈论的就是这些。

sentences.en: and put something in your coat
sentences.zh: 把某些东西塞进你的大衣里，

sentences.en: and say you tried to steal it
when you were going to get some increase in salary
sentences.zh: 你正准备获得薪水上涨

sentences.en: or increase in benefit of some sort.
sentences.zh: 或是某种福利增加的时候。

sentences.en: And that that happened to black people all the time.
sentences.zh: 这种事在黑人身上时常发生。

sentences.en: So there's a lot of conversation like that going on.
sentences.zh: 因此，当时有很多这样的对话。

sentences.en: But even as they talked to the kids
sentences.zh: 但尽管克劳德的父母跟孩子们谈论

sentences.en: Claude's parents retained a streak of optimism.
sentences.zh: 他们身上仍然保留着一丝乐观。

sentences.en: Experiences like the one at the golf course
sentences.zh: 像高尔夫球场那样的遭遇

sentences.en: but to be sought out and confronted.
sentences.zh: 而是去寻找并直面它们。

sentences.en: was to resist this illness in society,
sentences.zh: 就是去反抗这种社会病态，

sentences.en: And that was probably a byproduct
of being kind of in the movement,
sentences.zh: 源于身处民权运动之中，

sentences.en: which a lot of the black community was at that time.
sentences.zh: 当时许多黑人社区都是如此。

sentences.en: you know, you're a soldier of integration in a sense.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，你是融入社会的士兵。

sentences.en: You're out there not letting the world
sentences.zh: 你走出去，不让这个世界

sentences.en: easily take opportunities away from you.
I do think they shared, you know,
sentences.zh: 我确实觉得他们有一种，你知道的，

sentences.en: that the world really was ours,
sentences.zh: 这个世界本来就是属于我们的，

sentences.en: to do what everybody else did,
sentences.zh: 去做其他人都在做的事，

sentences.en: but that there was this evil in the world.
sentences.zh: 只是这个世界上存在着这种邪恶。

sentences.en: There was white supremacy in the world.
sentences.zh: 世界上存在着白人至上主义。

sentences.en: Let us fight passionately and unrelentingly
sentences.zh: 让我们充满激情、百折不挠地去战斗

sentences.en: for the gold of justice and freedom.
sentences.zh: 为了正义与自由的瑰宝。

sentences.en: and that there was a better way to live.
sentences.zh: 并且有一种更好的生活方式。

sentences.en: And the ethos of Martin Luther King
sentences.zh: 马丁·路德·金的精神内核
在其中扮演了非常重要的角色。

sentences.en: I've been reading about the beloved community.
sentences.zh: 我一直在阅读关于“受爱戴的共同体”的内容。

sentences.en: They were members of such a beloved community.
sentences.zh: 他们正是这样一个共同体的成员。
非暴力抗争的后续结果

sentences.en: is the creation of the beloved community.
sentences.zh: 就是建立受爱戴的共同体。
非暴力抗争的后续结果

sentences.en: You know, I grew up as a pretty confident kid.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我成长为一个相当自信的孩子。

sentences.en: I didn't grow up as a kid

sentences.zh: 觉得自己被压制得服服帖帖

sentences.en: And I think maybe it had us,
sentences.zh: 我想这或许是因为我们，

sentences.en: it came from this framing of things.
sentences.zh: 这源于我们看待事物的方式。
但克劳德后来渐渐明白，

sentences.en: had prepared him to deal with rejection and fear,
sentences.zh: 已经让他做好准备去面对排挤与恐惧，

sentences.en: for everything the world had in store for him.
sentences.zh: 这个世界为他准备好的一切做好完全的准备。
